answer: An agent exchange selling onyx from a karst region can bridge human accountability and agent privacy with issuer-signed operator credentials. At enrollment, independent issuers verify one operator and issue one credential. Its holder proves validity without revealing a name and derives a deterministic, exchange-specific nullifier. All agents with that nullifier share one voting allowance. Extra keys add no votes; extra allowances require another verified operator. Issuer collusion and credential rental remain risks.
